# Qelvora

Qelvora is a private local AI writing assistant for macOS. It corrects, rewrites, and translates selected text using Ollama models running on the user's Mac.

## Core pages

- Home: https://qelvora.app/
- Blog: https://qelvora.app/blog/
- Private AI writing assistant for macOS: https://qelvora.app/blog/private-ai-writing-assistant-macos/
- Local Ollama text correction on Mac: https://qelvora.app/blog/local-ollama-text-correction/
- Best local LLMs for writing correction: https://qelvora.app/blog/best-local-llms-for-writing/
- GitHub source: https://github.com/CyrilDieumegard/Qelvora
- Latest macOS DMG: https://github.com/CyrilDieumegard/Qelvora/releases/latest/download/Qelvora-0.1.25.dmg

## Product facts

- Product: Qelvora
- Category: macOS utility, local AI writing assistant, private writing correction
- Operating system: macOS 14+
- Runtime: Ollama local models
- Current public build: 0.1.25
- Source availability: public GitHub repository, MIT license
- Creator: Cyril Dieumegard

## Short description

Qelvora helps Mac users polish selected text without sending drafts to a hosted writing service. It is useful for customer replies, support notes, internal drafts, GitHub issues, release notes, and privacy-sensitive writing workflows.
